rounds.title: Weekend and Beyond
rounds.support: Ask and answer. What are you going to do this weekend? What is your favorite hobby?
rounds.challenge: What new hobbies will you try in the future? What skills will you need for them?
words: I am going to play football this weekend.
My favorite hobby is reading books.
I want to try cooking in the future.

rounds.title: Solo vs Team
rounds.support: Defend your side. Why is your hobby fun? Student C listens and chooses the winner.
rounds.challenge: Compare the options. How do these hobbies change people? C, decide who gives the best arguments.
words: Playing video games alone is relaxing.
Team sports are great because you make friends.
I think my hobby is better.

rounds.title: An Active Hobby
rounds.support: Describe the picture to your partner. What are the people doing? Do you like this activity?
rounds.challenge: Will people still do outdoor sports in 50 years? What are the advantages of indoor sports?
words: They are climbing a tall wall indoors.
The boy is wearing a blue shirt.
I want to try this because it looks fun.

rounds.title: The School Club
rounds.support: You want to start a club, but you have no money. Suggest free hobbies and agree on one.
rounds.challenge: How will you organize the club? What rules will you make to keep it free and fun?
words: We can start a running club.
Let's make a book club in the library.
That is a great idea, let's do it.

rounds.title: Quitting Time
rounds.support: A, tell your parent (B) you want to stop playing the guitar. B, ask why.
rounds.challenge: Negotiate. What other hobby will you do instead? How will it help your future?
words: I am going to stop my guitar lessons.
Why do you want to quit?
I am too tired after school.

rounds.title: Hobbies in 2060
rounds.support: Invent a fun new hobby for the future. Take turns adding ideas. What do people do?
rounds.challenge: Describe this futuristic hobby. What special technology will people need? Why will it be popular?
words: People will play football on the moon.
It will be a very fast game.
